candidates.reason: Window counting followed by DISTINCT preserves each hour group, including NULL, and returns BIGINT counts.
candidates.sql: SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime)) AS trips FROM trips

candidates.reason: Two-stage aggregation counts pickup-location subgroups and combines them per hour, casting the sum back to BIGINT.
candidates.sql: SELECT hour, CAST(SUM(partial_trips) AS BIGINT) AS trips FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, PULocationID, COUNT(*) AS partial_trips FROM trips GROUP BY 1, 2) AS partials GROUP BY hour

candidates.reason: Conditional aggregation retains the original day predicate and removes routes with no qualifying rows.
candidates.sql: SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) > 0

candidates.reason: Window counting over qualifying rows followed by DISTINCT preserves route groups, NULL keys, and duplicate counts.
candidates.sql: SELECT DISTINCT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY PULocationID, DOLocationID) AS trips FROM trips WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7
